structuralBaseline.note: Static Gradle and import DAGs enforce build and classloader boundaries; they never prove runtime functional independence across shared host state, events, or storage.

constraints.title: Host legal and binary integrity boundary
constraints.statement: Never redistribute Cubism binaries, bypass license checks, or weave unverified host bytecode.

constraints.title: SDK isolation and ABI boundary
constraints.statement: Restrict plugin dependencies to compileOnly :sdk without exposing com.live2d.*, runtime internals, or unapproved Swing and native handles.

constraints.title: Exact-version fail-closed compatibility
constraints.statement: Withdraw unverified capabilities per Cubism version without blocking official Editor startup or inventing fallback host state.

constraints.title: Interactive responsiveness and bounded execution
constraints.statement: Keep plugin callbacks, hooks, and background tasks within bounded queues, timeouts, and EDT dispatch budgets.

constraints.title: Single Editor write truth and generation safety
constraints.statement: Route attached-document mutations through host-thread Editor authoring transactions with native Undo parity and generation-bound stale rejection.

requirements.statement: Install, verify, and restore runtime bytecode hooks without blocking or corrupting official Cubism startup.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Every hook proves target digests before registration, refuses unverified hosts cleanly, and restores original bytes on close.

requirements.statement: Admit reviewed Cubism Editor versions and gate per-slice capabilities without cross-version selector drift.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: All 21 reviewed releases resolve exact capability sets offline, while unknown versions or missing aliases fail closed.

requirements.statement: Isolate plugin loading, service wiring, generation fencing, and teardown across concurrent plugins.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Failing, disabling, or fencing one plugin generation revokes its handles and hooks while leaving neighbor plugins active.

requirements.statement: Persist, validate, migrate, and recover typed configuration and scoped plugin storage atomically.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Valid schemas round-trip byte-deterministically, migrations capture pre-write recovery points, and failed migrations preserve prior bytes.

requirements.statement: Bound callback latency, background execution, and opt-in host render optimizations within interactive budgets.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Scheduler queues enforce work budgets and timeouts, EDT handoffs avoid raw waits, and optimization hooks provide persisted kill switches.

requirements.statement: Apply persisted theme colors before initial GL scene caching and restore native appearance on demand.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Valid persisted selections inject FlatLaf defaults before scene initialization, invalid files emit one bounded diagnostic, and native restore deletes custom defaults.

requirements.statement: Contribute, localize, and revoke menus, toolbars, context menus, panels, and shell views per plugin generation.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Each UI contribution requires granular permission, binds plugin localization, and disappears cleanly when its registration or generation closes.

requirements.statement: Execute host-thread model mutations with atomic Undo parity, lifecycle ordering, and coalesced selection observation.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Committed transactions produce one verified history entry, failed callbacks compensate to identical prior history, and concurrent edit scopes reject cleanly.

requirements.statement: Retain locked parameter values against interactive, synchronous, and programmatic edits per model GUID.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Locked parameters return their prior value during Before interception on the matching model GUID without leaking locks across models or after disable.

requirements.statement: Propagate normalized parameter edits across synchronized parameter sets without oscillation feedback loops.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Edits on an unlocked driver update unlocked synchronized targets proportionally on the UI thread with zero secondary bounce.

requirements.statement: Import, export, transfer, and bind parameter values and animation keyforms in grouped authoring transactions.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Batch parameter and keyform operations validate ranges up front and commit or roll back as atomic Undo units.

requirements.statement: Register, switch, and clean up custom mesh-editing tools under single-active-tool session mutual exclusion.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Activating one custom mesh tool revokes any prior active lease, and disabling or failing one tool leaves peer mesh tools operable.

requirements.statement: Edit ArtMesh and deformer geometry with mirror symmetry, row/column deform, and 3D import transactions.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Symmetric edits and 3D imports preserve vertex/deformer invariants and record reversible native Undo steps.

requirements.statement: Pack texture atlases, synchronize external PSD edits, back up projects, and export protected bundles safely.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Atlas, PSD, backup, and protected-export workflows preserve source project integrity and quiesce cleanly on plugin shutdown.

requirements.statement: Execute external MCP, ACP, and out-of-process script commands through permission-gated SDK and transaction boundaries.
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: External automation runs GraalVM outside the host JVM and enforces identical permission, transaction, and generation guards as in-host plugins.

designParameters.summary: VerifiedInstall bootstrap agent, HookManifest/WeavePlan ordering, and byte-restoration proof.
Host-independent compatibility-policy predicates plus runtime VerifiedMemberResolver and API availability interceptor.
LocalPluginRuntime, isolated PluginClassLoader, PluginGenerationGuard, DisposableScope, CorePluginContext composition seam, and RuntimeEventBroker.
Pure persistence-core typed-config kernel, atomic TypedConfigDocumentStore with recovery points, and confined RuntimePluginStorage.
RuntimeScheduler, PluginWorkExecutorRegistry, EdtDispatch, RuntimeAsyncHostReadService, and opt-in host performance hooks.
EarlyThemeAppearanceBootstrap pre-scene reader, shared ThemeRuntimeProperties custom defaults, RuntimeAppearanceService, and ui-theme ThemeSelectionConfig.
EditorUiContributionAuthority, UiCapabilityBundle registries, framework shell, and workspace/palette UI plugins.
EditorAuthoringTransactionCoordinator with shared editScopeGate, EditorBackedCubismModelAccess, ParameterLifecycleCoordinator, and SelectionQueryServiceImpl.
ParameterLockPlugin synchronous beforeSetParameterValue hook adapter and GUID-keyed ParameterLockState.
ParameterSyncPlugin @SubscribeEvent ParameterValueEvent.On subscriber, ParameterSyncEngine, ProgrammaticSuppressionGuard, and conflated UiScheduler flush.
Transactional parameter CSV, batch binding transfer, physics editor, and frame-animation keyform authoring plugins.
MeshToolCoordinator with ActivationLease, generation-scoped RuntimeMeshToolRegistry, and SDK mesh-tool plugins.
Mesh/deformer symmetry bridges, TemporaryDeformToolRegistry, and mirror/warp/3D-import plugins.
TextureAtlasLayoutCoordinator, RuntimePsdReplaceService, ExportSettingsContributionService, and atlas/PSD/backup/export plugins.
Out-of-process graal-host, permission-scoped McpConnectionService and ScriptService, plus mcp, acp, and command-palette plugins.

submatrices.title: Parameter Lock (FR9/DP9) vs Parameter Synchronization (FR10/DP10)
submatrices.sequencingRule: Plugin enable/disable order is invariant because DP9 intercepts ParameterValueEvent.Before while DP10 observes changed-only ParameterValueEvent.On; operators must configure locks (DP9) first and unlock parameters expected to follow DP10 sync.

submatrices.title: Independent Custom Mesh Tool Lifecycle (selection-brush, geometric-mesh-layout, turbo-mesh)
submatrices.sequencingRule: No plugin load or enable order is required: MeshToolCoordinator sorts toolbar contributions deterministically, enforces single-active-tool ActivationLease mutual exclusion, and isolates activation failures and disable teardown per (pluginId, generation).

submatrices.title: Pre-Scene Startup Theme Injection vs Runtime UI Theme Selection
submatrices.sequencingRule: ThemeSelectionConfig writes ui-theme/selection.cfg in typed-config v1 format during session N; EarlyThemeAppearanceBootstrap reads it read-only before GL scene initialization in session N+1 and hands off ThemeRuntimeProperties to RuntimeAppearanceService once plugins load.

triangularSequencing.scope: DP1 -> DP2 -> DP3 -> DP4 -> DP5 (Platform bootstrap and kernel)
triangularSequencing.rule: Verify host artifacts and weave bridges (DP1), resolve exact Cubism capabilities (DP2), initialize runtime schedulers and typed persistence (DP4, DP5), and only then admit plugin generations (DP3).
Inject persisted theme defaults into FlatLaf before Cubism initializes the GL scene (DP6), then attach plugin and shell UI contributions (DP7).

triangularSequencing.scope: DP8 -> DP9 -> DP10 -> DP11/DP15 (Parameter authoring and automation)
triangularSequencing.rule: Establish host-thread transaction and lifecycle coordinators (DP8), configure parameter locks (DP9) ahead of synchronization rules (DP10), and pause parameter-sync before running batch CSV, keyform, or MCP pose-grid sweeps (DP11, DP15).

triangularSequencing.scope: DP8 -> DP12 / DP13 / DP14 (Geometry and resource workflows)
triangularSequencing.rule: Open one mutually exclusive edit or mesh-tool lease at a time (DP8 editScopeGate, DP12 ActivationLease) and complete or exit custom mesh-tool sessions before invoking competing host-wide authoring transactions.

exceptions.title: Pre-startup theme selection reach-through in EarlyThemeAppearanceBootstrap
exceptions.summary: EarlyThemeAppearanceBootstrap reads config/dev.turboism.plugin.uitheme/ui-theme/selection.cfg and data/dev.turboism.plugin.uitheme/themes/<id>.zip before plugins load because Cubism caches its off-canvas GL background color on first scene access.
exceptions.evaluatedAlternative: Evaluated promoting startup theme selection to a runtime-owned AppearanceService document under config/turboism.core/appearance/ decoded via :persistence-core without altering pre-GL host timing; deferred because migrating existing user homes safely requires dual-read fallback and release-derived golden snapshots (#69).
exceptions.followUp: Keep the exception closed to ui-theme v1 selection.cfg pinned by EarlyThemeBootstrapInteractionTest; revisit runtime-owned storage only alongside #69 persistence migration fixtures.

exceptions.title: ParameterLockPlugin preload fail-closed window and ParameterSyncPlugin 500ms unconsumed suppression window
exceptions.summary: ParameterLockPlugin retains current values for all parameters of an active model until async lock preload completes; when a locked target rejects a ParameterSyncPlugin write, no On event fires and ProgrammaticSuppressionGuard retains a 500ms suppression entry on that target (plus an unread lastAppliedValues entry).
exceptions.evaluatedAlternative: Clearing suppressionGuard when post-setValue readback equals the pre-write value eliminates the 500ms post-unlock suppression window without adding cross-plugin coupling.
exceptions.followUp: Track post-write readback cleanup of ProgrammaticSuppressionGuard and removal of unread lastAppliedValues in a focused parameter-sync maintenance issue.

exceptions.title: Asynchronous ParameterSyncPlugin UI flush vs synchronous batch and MCP parameter sweeps
exceptions.summary: ParameterSyncPlugin receives ParameterValueEvent.On asynchronously and flushes partner updates via UiScheduler after synchronous host-thread transactions such as McpPoseGridDomain finish.
exceptions.evaluatedAlternative: Suppressing or deferring user-interactive parameter-sync during explicit batch AuthoringTransaction scopes or MCP pose-grid capture avoids unintended partner drift without coupling plugin modules.
exceptions.followUp: Execute verification tasks on (FR10, DP15), (FR11, DP10), and (FR15, DP10) before introducing transaction-origin metadata on ParameterValueEvent.

exceptions.title: CorePluginContext service-wiring fan-out vs feature-policy ownership
exceptions.summary: CorePluginContext wires four capability bundles and 31+ PluginService slots with 19 convenience/test constructors, creating high static import fan-out in :runtime.
exceptions.evaluatedAlternative: Splitting :runtime or CorePluginContext into per-feature Gradle modules was evaluated and rejected: CorePluginContext owns only service assembly, permission wrapping, and DisposableScope registration, not domain policy.
exceptions.followUp: Retain single :runtime module boundary enforced by checkModuleBoundaries and checkDependencyInventory; trim test-only CorePluginContext constructor overloads opportunistically.
